meta.title: Domi Adiwijaya
meta.description: Explore the portfolio, technical insights, and innovative projects of Domi Adiwijaya, a professional Tech & Homelab Enthusiast.

hero.blurb: I design and deliver dependable systems. From homelab architectures to production-grade automation, I translate complex constraints into solutions that are both elegant and resilient.

about.lead: I’m driven to make technology meaningfully better, whether in a controlled homelab or by helping others resolve complex, real-world challenges.
about.p1: I’m Domi. A lifelong technologist, I’ve turned early curiosity into a disciplined practice of designing systems that solve consequential, real-world problems.
about.p2: My homelab serves as a focused R&D environment: I stress-test, intentionally break, and harden ideas, then productionize what proves robust.
about.p3: Beyond configuration and automation, I codify and share what I learn so others can navigate complexity faster. The moment when everything clicks and simply works is the goal.

innovation.title: Tech Innovation
innovation.description: I evaluate emerging technologies and architect elegant, scalable solutions to consequential problems.

homelab.title: Homelab R&D
homelab.description: A controlled environment where I stress-test, harden, and productionize ideas before they encounter real traffic.

automation.title: Automation-First
automation.description: Anything repeated twice becomes a candidate for reliable, idempotent automation.

sharing.title: Knowledge Sharing
sharing.description: I distill lessons into docs, demos, and talks to accelerate learning across teams.

skills.lead: The toolchain I rely on to design, automate, and operate systems that remain elegant under load and predictable in failure.

tail.title: Never Stop Learning
tail.body: Technology evolves daily. I run continuous experiments to stress-test new tools, refine my practice, and deliver measurably better outcomes.

services.lead: From end-to-end infrastructure to that one stubborn task you want off your plate, I deliver pragmatic, durable solutions.

homelab.title: Homelab Setup
homelab.description: Design and deploy a purpose-built homelab for learning, staging, or self-hosting, grounded in resilient networking, virtualization, and storage.

cloud.title: Cloud Migration
cloud.description: De-risk your move to the cloud with a pragmatic, cost-aware plan and a fit-for-purpose target architecture.

security.title: Security Setup
security.description: Establish pragmatic security controls that materially reduce risk without slowing delivery.

automation.title: Reliable Automation
automation.description: Eliminate toil with robust, idempotent automation so you can focus on outcomes that matter.

monitoring.title: Monitoring & Alerts
monitoring.description: Gain actionable visibility and early signal across systems, well before users feel the impact.

data.title: Data & Backups
data.description: Protect critical data with resilient backups, rapid recovery, and disciplined lifecycle management.

tail.title: Need Something Different?
tail.body: Contexts vary and templates rarely fit. Tell me what you need, and we will design a solution that aligns with your goals, constraints, and timelines.

contact.lead: Have an initiative to scope or a problem space to unpack? Reach out, I’m keen to understand your objectives and outline a pragmatic path forward.

drop.title: Drop Me a Line
drop.body: Use the form below or send an email, whichever is more convenient. I read every message.

form.message_ph: Briefly outline goals, constraints, and timelines.

connect.title: Let’s Connect
connect.body: Whether you’re validating a concept, scaling an existing system, or seeking a second opinion, I’m happy to engage and provide clear next steps.
